products.name: Broker
products.description: Installed on the license server machine. Facilitates communication between the OpenLM Platform and license managers.

products.name: SaaS Agent
products.description: Meters license usage for cloud platforms such as Autodesk Cloud and LinkedIn, and reports the data to the Broker Hub for monitoring and allocation management.
products.notes: Distributed as a Windows executable (.exe). The redirect URL contains '-msi' for legacy reasons.

products.name: Workstation Agent
products.description: Lightweight application that runs on the user's workstation. Captures real usage data and idle times, identifies idle open sessions, and safely releases them.
products.notes: This version is required for compatibility with Dongle Monitoring.

products.name: Directory Synchronization Agent
products.description: Works with Directory Synchronization Service (DSS) by retrieving sync definitions, collecting user data from domain directories, and sending it back to DSS.
products.requirements: For local directories (e.g. LDAP), needs network access to the directory. For cloud directories (e.g. Azure AD, Google), needs external internet access.

products.name: AI Proxy
products.description: AI Proxy component for the OpenLM Platform.
products.notes: Distributed as a Docker image. Shipping mechanism not finalized; treat URL as provisional.

products.name: OpenLM SLM
products.description: OpenLM Software License Manager. Core legacy server component for license monitoring and management.
products.requirements: .NET 8 SDK required (not installed automatically). Microsoft SQL Server 2014 is no longer supported.
products.notes: Upgrading to v26 requires a new license file. Stop the OpenLM SLM service and back up the database before upgrading. Contact sales@openlm.com for the new license.

products.name: Identity Service
products.description: Facilitates user management and authentication of OpenLM products' users. Relies on OpenID and OAuth 2.0.

products.name: Broker
products.description: Provides added functionality to OpenLM SLM, such as denials monitoring. Install one instance per license manager server.

products.name: AutoCAD Plugin
products.description: Shows real usage and idle time for AutoCAD. Identifies and safely releases idle open sessions. Supports Autodesk Cloud.
products.notes: The standalone AutoCAD plugin is being discontinued. The current v25 build remains available, but no further updates are planned.

products.name: Workstation Agent
products.description: Shows engineering applications' real usage and idle time. Identifies and safely releases idle open sessions. Install on any number of workstations.
products.compatibility: End-User Services v23.1+, App Manager v24.1+
products.notes: When upgrading ArcGIS Pro to a newer major version, reinstall the Workstation Agent so the new extension loads correctly.

products.name: End-User Services
products.description: User interface for OpenLM Workstation Agent. Lets users view license servers and license usage information.
products.compatibility: Requires OpenLM SLM v25.10 or later. Earlier SLM versions are not supported.
products.requirements: Windows installer requires .NET Framework 8 runtime or higher.
products.notes: Upgrade SLM before deploying or upgrading EUS v26.03.

products.name: ServiceNow Adapter
products.description: Integrates OpenLM data into ServiceNow. Specializes in IT service management (ITSM) applications and automates common business processes.

products.name: Directory Synchronization Agent
products.description: Executes sync definitions for the legacy Directory Sync. Part of the Directory Sync product family with DSS.
products.notes: If upgrading DSA from v25.6.11.909 to v26.3.30.1038, Azure AD sync may fail. Either repair the install (Programs and Features → Repair) or perform a clean uninstall and reinstall. Clean installs and future releases are not affected.

products.name: Directory Synchronization Service
products.description: Syncs the OpenLM database with directory services that support LDAP. Manages sync definitions and Directory Synchronization Agents.

products.name: Reporting Hub
products.description: Advanced querying capabilities, extended data modeling, and custom report creation for business intelligence.

products.name: Applications Manager
products.description: Monitors and controls the use of any software in the organization regardless of the licensing scheme.
products.compatibility: Workstation Agents older than v24 are not compatible with the latest Applications Manager.

products.name: Reports Scheduler
products.description: Generates predefined reports and submits them to specific recipients on a schedule.
